metadata.name: PlanPayOff
metadata.description: This API is used to get the payoff details of any plan for an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: PlanID
request_fields.description: Credit Plan Segment Account ID. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: PayOffDate
request_fields.description: Date when Pay off has been made. Note: 1.If a payment is received with a backdated transaction(Date less than PayOffDate) and the amount is greater than or equal to the PayOffAmount returned by the PayOff API, the system will automatically adjust the payment date to the current date. 2.If the payment amount is less than the PayOffAmount, the payment can be posted with the backdated date. Format:Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example:12/20/2019

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PlanSequence
children.description: Sequence number of the plan Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1

children.name: PlanID
children.description: Credit Plan Segment Account ID. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account/Debtor Owing Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: Principal
children.description: Principal amount of loan From  Summary header Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: PayOffAmount
children.description: PayOff Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: PayOffInterestDebit
children.description: PayOff Interest Debit Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: PayOffInterestCredit
children.description: PayOff Interest Credit Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: CreditPlanType
children.description: This field populates Credit Plan Type. Valid Values: 0 - Purchase 2 - Cash 7 - Misc. 10 - Fees 11 - Installment Loan Type 1 12 - Promotional 13 - Balance Transfer 14 - Promotional Purchases 15 - Promotional Balance Transfers 16 - Retail Format: XXXX Example: 0

children.name: CreditPlanName
children.description: This field describes the name/description of the Plan Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: XYZ_Revolving Plan

children.name: PayOffDate
children.description: Date when payoff has been made. Note: 1.If a payment is received with a backdated transaction(Date less than PayOffDate) and the amount is greater than or equal to the PayOffAmount returned by the PayOff API, the system will automatically adjust the payment date to the current date. 2.If the payment amount is less than the PayOffAmount, the payment can be posted with the backdated date. Format:Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example:12/20/2019

children.name: RequestTime
children.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

children.name: PayOffPerdiemAmount
children.description: This field should populate the $ amount of daily interest to be accrued for the plan. PayOffPerdiem value will not be populated for the plan in which interest on interest is applicable. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: TotalPayoffAmount
children.description: Total Payoff Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00
